note: One row per title entrance, effect and exit (1.29.0). kit/rules.cjs reads the names and the exit moves from here; kit/overlay.html draws them and keeps its own lists, which npm run check compares with this table (tests/title-table.test.cjs). needs: what a title must have for the effect to be drawn (digits: a number in the key word; swap: a list of words to roll through; number: a number you say; lines2: two or more lines; cut: a cut where the title ends). fallback: what is drawn when a need is not met, and the build log says so: a named effect is never swapped in silence. build means the title's plain build (word, letter or line); none means the title just ends. Exit rows also say what the picture does at the cut the title ends on: xfade (a stock ffmpeg xfade mode, {"custom": id} for a drawn one in kit/xfx.cjs, or null for a hard cut), dur and lead in seconds (lead is how much plays before the cut, under the title), sound (a pack sound id for the sound map, or null) and replaces (the named transition it stands in for). idea from mojomast/open-higgsfield-skills skills/video-director references/routing.md (MIT); preset shape from its skills/shot-transitions references/seam-presets.py.txt (MIT; Seam).
